tools.name: ping
tools.title: Ping the bridge
tools.description: Check that the After Effects bridge is alive and responding. Returns AE version, open project, bridge uptime and round-trip latency in ms. Use this first when unsure whether After Effects is reachable.

tools.name: ae_info
tools.title: AE capabilities info
tools.description: Read-only environment report: AE version and build, bridge version, whether the security preference 'Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network' is on, number of open items, available AE features (saveFrameToPng, app.effects, app.fonts), and paths (bridge runtime dir, project file).

tools.name: get_active_item
tools.title: Active item and selection
tools.description: Return the currently active item (comp or footage), selected layers in the active comp and selected properties. Useful to discover what the user is looking at before mutating anything.

tools.name: menu_command
tools.title: Execute menu command
tools.description: Execute an After Effects menu command by numeric id (app.findMenuCommandId / app.executeCommand). Try name first ('Purge All Memory & Disk Cache'); the bridge falls back to the numeric id. Use for commands with no dedicated tool.

command.description: Menu command name or numeric id.

tools.name: run_script
tools.title: Run ExtendScript
tools.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript code inside After Effects and return the serialized result. Wrap the value you want back in a return statement; the code runs inside (function(){ ... })() so 'return' is legal. Only plain JSON-safe values (numbers, strings, booleans, null, arrays, objects) are returned. DANGEROUS: gated behind AE_MCP_ENABLE_EVAL=1 on the MCP server.

tools.name: help_bridge
tools.title: Bridge help
tools.description: Return installation and troubleshooting instructions for the ae_bridge.jsx resident bridge (no After Effects round-trip, always available). Read this when ping fails to understand how to recover.

tools.name: project_info
tools.title: Project info
tools.description: Full project overview: file path, dirty flag, bits per channel, time display type, item census by type, folder tree and the active item.

tools.name: project_list_items
tools.title: List project items
tools.description: List items in the project panel with id, name, type, folder, path and summary. Filter by type ('comp' | 'folder' | 'footage' | 'solid'), by name substring, or by parent folder id/name.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on item name.

folder.description: Only items directly inside this folder (id or name; 'root' = project root).

tools.name: project_new
tools.title: New project
tools.description: Create a new empty project. If the current project has unsaved changes it is saved first (never discarded silently).

save_current.description: Save the current project first if dirty (default true).

tools.name: project_open
tools.title: Open project
tools.description: Open an .aep project file. Missing-footage and save dialogs are suppressed by the bridge; missing footage is reported in the response.

tools.name: project_save
tools.title: Save project
tools.description: Save the current project. With 'path' performs Save As (returns the new path); without it saves in place (errors if the project was never saved).

path.description: Absolute target path for Save As.

tools.name: project_close
tools.title: Close project
tools.description: Close the current project. By default unsaved changes are saved first; set save=false to discard them.

tools.name: project_import_file
tools.title: Import footage
tools.description: Import a file into the project: image, video, audio, layered PSD/AI (set psd_mode to choose which layers), or an image sequence (set sequence=true and pass the first frame path). Returns the new footage item.

path.description: Absolute path to the file (or first frame of a sequence).

folder.description: Project-panel folder to place the item in (id or name).

tools.name: project_consolidate
tools.title: Consolidate footage
tools.description: Merge duplicate footage items pointing at the same file (app.project.consolidateFootage). Returns the number of items removed.

tools.name: project_remove_unused
tools.title: Remove unused footage
tools.description: Delete all footage items that are not used in any composition (app.project.removeUnusedFootage). Returns the number removed.

tools.name: project_reduce
tools.title: Reduce project
tools.description: Reduce the project to only what is used by the given compositions (app.project.reduceProject). Everything unrelated is deleted - save first!

keep_comps.description: Comps to keep (names or ids); everything used by them stays.

tools.name: project_set_bit_depth
tools.title: Set color depth
tools.description: Set project bits per channel (8/16/32) via the Project Settings command.

tools.name: item_rename
tools.title: Rename item
tools.description: Rename any project item (comp, footage, folder) by id or current name.

tools.name: item_delete
tools.title: Delete item
tools.description: Delete a project item. Comps delete only themselves; footage in use may still be deleted (check usages first with project_list_items if unsure).

tools.name: folder_create
tools.title: Create folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the project panel, optionally inside another folder.

parent.description: Parent folder id or name (default: project root).

tools.name: item_move
tools.title: Move item to folder
tools.description: Move an item into a folder (or to the project root with folder='root').

folder.description: Target folder id or name, or 'root'.

tools.name: comp_create
tools.title: Create composition
tools.description: Create a new composition. Returns its summary (id, name, size, duration, fps, background color).

background_color.description: Background color, RGB. Use 0-255 values (e.g. [10,20,30]) or 0-1 floats (all <=1).

folder.description: Project-panel folder to place the comp in (id or name).

tools.name: comp_list
tools.title: List compositions
tools.description: List every composition in the project with id, name, size, duration, fps and layer count.

tools.name: comp_info
tools.title: Composition details
tools.description: Detailed info about one composition: settings, work area, motion blur, markers, and a layer summary list (index, name, type, enabled, timing).

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: comp_set_settings
tools.title: Set composition settings
tools.description: Change composition settings: width/height (pair only), pixel aspect, duration, frame rate, background color, motion blur, shutter angle/phase, and the work area.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

shutter_angle.description: Motion blur shutter angle in degrees (1-720).

shutter_phase.description: Motion blur shutter phase in degrees.

tools.name: comp_duplicate
tools.title: Duplicate composition
tools.description: Duplicate a composition. The duplicate gets '-copy' in its name unless new_name is given. Duplicate layers keep their sources (not shared).

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: comp_delete
tools.title: Delete composition
tools.description: Delete a composition from the project.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: comp_precompose
tools.title: Pre-compose layers
tools.description: Pre-compose the given layers into a new composition (layer indices or names, 1-based). By default all attributes move (equivalent of 'Move all attributes').

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layers.description: Layers to precompose: 1-based indices or names.

tools.name: layer_add_solid
tools.title: Add solid layer
tools.description: Add a solid to a composition. Set adjustment=true to create an adjustment layer instead (color is irrelevant then).

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

width.description: Solid width in pixels (default: comp width).

height.description: Solid height in pixels (default: comp height).

folder.description: Project-panel folder for the solid item (id or name).

tools.name: layer_add_null
tools.title: Add null layer
tools.description: Add a null object layer (100x100 by default) to a composition.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: layer_add_text
tools.title: Add text layer
tools.description: Add a text layer with content and optional style. 'font' must be the PostScript font name (e.g. 'Montserrat-Bold'); use text_list_fonts to look it up. Supports box text with a fixed box size.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

stroke_width.description: Stroke width in pixels (0 = no stroke).

box_text.description: Create paragraph (box) text instead of point text.

box_width.description: Box text width in pixels (with box_text).

box_height.description: Box text height in pixels (with box_text).

tools.name: layer_add_shape
tools.title: Add shape layer
tools.description: Add a shape layer with one shape group: rectangle, ellipse, star or polygon, with fill and optional stroke.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

stroke_width.description: Stroke width in pixels (0 = no stroke, default 0).

tools.name: layer_add_camera
tools.title: Add camera layer
tools.description: Add a camera to a composition and return its layer info. Point of interest defaults to comp center when two_node is used.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

position.description: Camera position [x, y, z] (default centered, -comp height).

point_of_interest.description: Point of interest [x, y, z] (two-node cameras).

two_node.description: Two-node camera driven by Point of Interest.

tools.name: layer_add_light
tools.title: Add light layer
tools.description: Add a light to a composition: point, spot, parallel or ambient.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: layer_add_footage
tools.title: Add footage layer
tools.description: Add an existing project item (footage, solid, or another comp) as a layer into a composition.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

item.description: Project item id or name to add as a layer.

fit_to_comp.description: Scale the layer to fit the comp frame.

tools.name: layer_duplicate
tools.title: Duplicate layer
tools.description: Duplicate a layer; the copy sits directly above the original. Optionally rename it and offset its start time.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

shift_s.description: Shift the duplicate start time by this many seconds.

tools.name: layer_delete
tools.title: Delete layer
tools.description: Delete one or more layers from a composition.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layers to delete: 1-based indices or names.

tools.name: layer_list
tools.title: List layers
tools.description: List layers of a composition: index, name, type, enabled/solo/lock/shy, 3D flag, parent, timing (start/in/out), label color.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

only_matching_type.description: Return only layers of this type.

tools.name: layer_info
tools.title: Layer details
tools.description: Everything about one layer: type, source dimensions/fps, transform values, flags, timing, parenting, effects list (with matchNames), masks summary, markers, text document, keyframe counts per animated property.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

tools.name: layer_set_flags
tools.title: Set layer flags
tools.description: Toggle layer flags: enabled, solo, shy, locked, three_d (3D layer), guide, audio_enabled, motion_blur, adjustment, auto_orient, environment_layer.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

tools.name: layer_set_parent
tools.title: Set layer parent
tools.description: Parent/unparent a layer. keep_transform=true adjusts the child transform so the layer does not jump (pick-whip style parenting).

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

parent.description: Parent layer 1-based index or name, or 'none' to unparent.

keep_transform.description: Adjust child transform so nothing jumps (default true).

tools.name: layer_reorder
tools.title: Reorder layer
tools.description: Move a layer within the stacking order: to top/bottom, before/after another layer, or to a specific index.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: layer_trim
tools.title: Trim layer
tools.description: Set a layer's in/out points and/or start time. All values are seconds in comp time.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: layer_split
tools.title: Split layer
tools.description: Split a layer at a given comp time (like Edit > Split Layer): the part before the cut keeps the original timing, the part after is a duplicate.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

time_s.description: Split time in seconds (default: current time indicator).

tools.name: layer_set_quality
tools.title: Set layer quality
tools.description: Set layer quality (draft/best) and per-layer motion blur sampling.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: transform_set
tools.title: Set transform
tools.description: Set transform values on a layer in one call: position, scale (percent), rotation (degrees), opacity (percent), anchor point, orientation and per-axis X/Y/Z rotation for 3D layers. Values may be scalars or [x,y]/[x,y,z] arrays as appropriate for the property.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

scale.description: Scale percent [x, y] or [x, y, z] (100 = 100%).

anchor_point.description: Anchor point [x, y] or [x, y, z].

set_keyframe.description: Also create a keyframe at the current time for each changed property.

tools.name: prop_get
tools.title: Get property value
tools.description: Read a property's value at a time, its keyframe count, expression, unit and dimension. Path examples: 'Transform.Position', 'Opacity', 'Effects.Gaussian Blur.Blurriness', 'Source Text', 'Marker'.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

path.description: Property path from the layer, '.'-separated (matchName or display name segments).

tools.name: prop_set
tools.title: Set property value
tools.description: Set any property by path. Creates a keyframe at 'time_s' if keyframe=true (the property is animated automatically). For Source Text pass a string or {...} TextDocument-like object; for colors pass [r,g,b].

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

time_s.description: Keyframe time in seconds (default: current time).

keyframe.description: Create a keyframe instead of setting a static value.

tools.name: prop_list
tools.title: List property tree
tools.description: Dump the property tree of a layer (or of a single property subtree): matchName, display name, type, dimension, animated/keyframe counts, current value. Cap depth to keep responses small.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

tools.name: prop_clear
tools.title: Clear property
tools.description: Remove the expression and/or all keyframes from a property.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: blend_mode_set
tools.title: Set blend mode
tools.description: Set a layer's blending mode: normal, multiply, screen, overlay, add, dissolve, dancing_dissolve, darken, lighten, classic_color_burn, classic_color_dodge, color_burn, color_dodge, hard_light, soft_light, vivid_light, linear_light, pin_light, hard_mix, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity, stencil_alpha, stencil_luma, silhouette_alpha, silhouette_luma, alpha_add, luminescent_premultiply.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: track_matte_set
tools.title: Set track matte
tools.description: Set the track matte of a layer: none, alpha, alpha_inverted, luma, luma_inverted. The matte is the layer DIRECTLY ABOVE the target layer.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: keyframe_set
tools.title: Set keyframes
tools.description: Create or update keyframes on a property. Pass a single time+value or parallel arrays 'times' and 'values' for multi-keyframe animation in one call. Times are seconds; values are scalars, [x,y]/[x,y,z] arrays, or [r,g,b] colors depending on the property.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

times.description: Array of keyframe times in seconds (multi form).

values.description: Array of values, same length as times (multi form).

tools.name: keyframe_remove
tools.title: Remove keyframes
tools.description: Remove keyframes from a property by 1-based index, by time, by time range, or all of them.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

time_s.description: Remove the keyframe nearest this time (within 1 frame).

range.description: Remove keys with time inside [start, end].

tools.name: keyframe_list
tools.title: List keyframes
tools.description: List all keyframes of a property: index, time, value, interpolation in/out, temporal ease (speed/influence), hold flag and spatial tangents where applicable.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: keyframe_set_interpolation
tools.title: Set keyframe interpolation/easing
tools.description: Set interpolation type and temporal easing of existing keyframes. Interp: linear, bezier, hold, auto_bezier. Ease arrays: per-key [in_speed, in_influence, out_speed, out_influence] or a single value applied to all selected keys. Influences are percent 0.1-100.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

ease_in.description: Incoming ease: [speed, influence%] per key or flat for all.

ease_out.description: Outgoing ease: [speed, influence%] per key or flat for all.

tools.name: keyframe_set_spatial
tools.title: Set spatial interpolation
tools.description: Set spatial auto-bezier/linear/tangent behavior of keyframes on spatial properties (Position, Anchor Point, mask paths).

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tangent_in.description: Incoming spatial tangent offset [x, y] (single key only).

tangent_out.description: Outgoing spatial tangent offset [x, y] (single key only).

tools.name: keyframe_shift
tools.title: Shift keyframes
tools.description: Shift all keyframes of a property (or a time range of them) by a delta in seconds. Negative delta moves earlier.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

range.description: Only shift keys with time inside [start, end].

tools.name: expression_set
tools.title: Set expression
tools.description: Set (or replace) an expression on a property. The response reports the expression error text if AE rejected it. Set expression='' to remove.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

tools.name: expression_get
tools.title: Get expression
tools.description: Read the expression source of a property and its current error text (empty string when the expression evaluates cleanly).

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: expression_remove
tools.title: Remove expression
tools.description: Remove the expression from a property.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: expression_scan_errors
tools.title: Scan expression errors
tools.description: Scan a composition (or the whole project) for properties whose expression has errors and return the list with paths and error texts.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: scan whole project).

tools.name: effect_add
tools.title: Add effect
tools.description: Add an effect to a layer by matchName (e.g. 'ADBE Gaussian Blur 2') or by display name substring (e.g. 'Gaussian Blur'). Optionally set parameters right away: {'Blurriness': 25, 'Repeat Edge Pixels': true}.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

match_name.description: Exact effect matchName (preferred, e.g. 'ADBE Gaussian Blur 2').

name.description: Effect display name substring (used when match_name is not given).

params.description: Parameters to set after adding: {name or matchName: value}.

index.description: Insert position in the effect stack (1-based; default: top of stack).

tools.name: effect_remove
tools.title: Remove effect
tools.description: Remove one or all effects from a layer by 1-based index or name.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

effect.description: Effect 1-based index or name; omit with all=true.

all.description: Remove every effect from the layer.

tools.name: effect_list_installed
tools.title: List installed effects
tools.description: List effects available in this AE build with their matchNames and categories (from app.effects on AE 2024+; falls back to a curated common list). Filter by category or name substring.

tools.name: effect_get_params
tools.title: Get effect parameters
tools.description: Dump the parameter tree of an effect instance on a layer: each parameter's matchName, display name, type, dimension, value and keyframe count.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: effect_set_params
tools.title: Set effect parameters
tools.description: Set parameters of an effect instance in one call: {'Blurriness': 25, 'Checkbox Control': true, 'Color Control': [255,0,0]} - keys may be display names or matchNames. Values may include {'value': v, 'time_s': t, 'keyframe': true} for keyframed setting.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: text_set_content
tools.title: Set text content
tools.description: Replace the content of a text layer (Source Text). Supports multi-line strings.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Text layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

set_keyframe.description: Keyframe the Source Text at the current time.

tools.name: text_set_style
tools.title: Set text style
tools.description: Update the style of a text layer's Source Text document: font (PostScript name), size, fill/stroke colors, stroke width, tracking, leading, justification, box text size, and baseline shift.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

set_keyframe.description: Keyframe Source Text at the current time after styling.

tools.name: text_list_fonts
tools.title: List fonts
tools.description: List installed fonts (family, style, PostScript name) available to AE. AE 2024+ reads app.fonts; older builds return a common curated list. Filter by family or PostScript name substring.

tools.name: text_add_animator
tools.title: Add text animator
tools.description: Add an animator group to a text layer: animates one or more of opacity, position, rotation, scale, tracking, fill color, stroke color, blur. A range selector is added with start/end/offset (percent) which can be keyframed afterwards with keyframe_set on path '<animator>.Range Selector.Start'.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

values.description: Start values for the chosen properties ({'opacity': 0, 'tracking': 50, ...}).

tools.name: shape_add
tools.title: Add shape group
tools.description: Add a shape group to an existing shape layer (or create the layer if 'layer' is omitted). rect | ellipse | star | polygon with fill/stroke.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Shape layer 1-based index or name (default: first shape layer, else new layer).

position.description: Group position [x, y] within the layer (default [0,0]).

fill_color.description: Fill color RGB 0-255 or 0-1 floats (omit to keep no fill on this group).

tools.name: shape_set_fill
tools.title: Set shape fill
tools.description: Change the fill of a shape layer group (or of all groups when group is omitted): color and/or opacity. Creates the fill if the group has none.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

group.description: Group 1-based index or name (default: all groups).

tools.name: shape_set_stroke
tools.title: Set shape stroke
tools.description: Change the stroke of a shape layer group (or all groups): color, width, opacity, line cap and line join. Creates the stroke if missing.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

group.description: Group 1-based index or name (default: all groups).

dashes.description: Dash pattern in pixels (e.g. [20, 14]; empty = solid).

tools.name: shape_add_modifier
tools.title: Add shape modifier
tools.description: Add a path modifier to a shape layer group or layer: trim_paths, round_corners, repeater, wiggle_paths, zig_zag, offset_paths, pucker_bloat, twist, merge_paths.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

group.description: Group 1-based index or name (default: layer level).

params.description: Modifier parameters, e.g. {'Start':0,'End':50,'Offset':25} for trim_paths, {'Copies':3,'Offset Position':[50,0]} for repeater.

tools.name: mask_add
tools.title: Add mask
tools.description: Add a mask to a layer: rectangle/ellipse from bounds, or a custom Bezier path from vertex + in/out-tangent lists (pixels, layer coordinates).

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

layer.description: Layer 1-based index or name (default: first selected).

bounds.description: Bounding box [left, top, width, height] in layer coordinates.

vertices.description: Custom path: array of [x, y] vertices.

in_tangents.description: Array of [x, y] in-tangents (same length as vertices).

out_tangents.description: Array of [x, y] out-tangents (same length as vertices).

tools.name: mask_update
tools.title: Update mask
tools.description: Update an existing mask: mode, inverted, feather, opacity, expansion, bounds (regenerates the path) or vertices/tangents.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

bounds.description: New bounding box [left, top, width, height].

tools.name: mask_remove
tools.title: Remove mask
tools.description: Remove one or all masks from a layer.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

mask.description: Mask 1-based index or name; omit with all=true.

tools.name: marker_add
tools.title: Add marker
tools.description: Add a comp marker or a layer marker with comment, chapter, URL, duration and cue-point name.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: marker_list
tools.title: List markers
tools.description: List all markers of a composition (and optionally of its layers): time, duration, comment, chapter, URL, cue point.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

tools.name: marker_remove
tools.title: Remove marker
tools.description: Remove markers by 1-based index, by time (within half a frame) or by comment match - from a comp or a layer.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

time_s.description: Remove the marker nearest this time.

comment_contains.description: Remove every marker whose comment contains this substring.

tools.name: time_remap_enable
tools.title: Enable time remap
tools.description: Enable Time Remapping on a footage/video layer, optionally seeding it with two keyframes (full duration linear) or an expression.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

seed_keyframes.description: Add a 2-keyframe linear map over the layer (default true).

expression.description: Expression to set on Time Remap instead of keyframes.

tools.name: time_stretch
tools.title: Stretch layer time
tools.description: Change the playback speed of a layer: pass stretch_percent (100 = normal speed, 50 = twice as fast, 200 = half speed) and optionally a new in_point; the out point follows automatically.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

new_in_point.description: Where the layer starts after stretching (seconds).

tools.name: render_queue_add
tools.title: Add comp to render queue
tools.description: Add a composition to the Render Queue with an output file. 'format' picks an installed Output Module template by format ('PNG', 'ProRes', 'H264', 'Lossless'...) or set 'output_template' to use it verbatim.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

output_path.description: Absolute output file path (extension sets the container).

format.description: Preferred format family for template lookup.

tools.name: render_queue_list
tools.title: List render queue
tools.description: List render queue items with status, comp, elapsed time and output paths.

tools.name: render_queue_control
tools.title: Control render queue
tools.description: Start/pause/stop the render queue, or remove items by index.

tools.name: render_start
tools.title: Render now
tools.description: Queue a comp with output settings and render it to completion (blocking; the MCP call returns when the render finishes, with per-item status and timing). This is the main 'export a file' tool.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

format.description: Preferred format family for template lookup.

tools.name: frame_render
tools.title: Render preview frame
tools.description: Render one or more frames of a composition to PNG for quick visual verification (uses comp.saveFrameToPng; AE 2023+). Returns absolute file paths the agent can open/read.

comp.description: Comp id or name (default: active comp).

scale_percent.description: Reserved for future use; frames render at comp size.

tools.name: aerender_render
tools.title: Render via aerender
tools.description: Render a project/comp headlessly with aerender.exe (runs OUTSIDE the open AE instance as a subprocess, so it works even while the user keeps editing). Returns the aerender exit code, stdout tail and output paths.

project_path.description: Absolute .aep path (default: the open project file, saved first).

comp.description: Comp name or index inside the project ('-comp').

timeout_s.description: Kill aerender after this many seconds (default 3600).

tools.name: footage_info
tools.title: Footage details
tools.description: Details of a footage item: path, dimensions, fps, duration (or still flag), alpha interpretation, audio/video presence, usage count across comps.

tools.name: footage_replace
tools.title: Replace footage
tools.description: Point a footage item at a different file (relink/swap source) - all layers using it update automatically.

path.description: Absolute path of the new file.

sequence.description: Treat the new file as an image sequence.

tools.name: footage_reload
tools.title: Reload footage
tools.description: Reload a footage item from disk (after the file changed on disk).

tools.name: footage_interpret
tools.title: Interpret footage
tools.description: Set interpretation of a footage item: conform frame rate, loop count, alpha mode and premultiplied color, field order, and 'guess' presets.

premultiplied_color.description: Matte color RGB 0-255 or 0-1 floats (premultiplied mode).

guess_frame_rate.description: Try 'Guess' frame rate before applying conform_fps.

tools.name: layers_batch
tools.title: Batch operations (one undo group)
tools.description: Execute several tool calls in ONE round-trip and ONE undo group - far faster than N separate calls. Each entry: {'tool': '<tool name>', 'args': {...}}. Every entry runs; per-entry ok/error is returned. Use for building whole scenes (add 10 layers, keyframe 5 properties, ...).

continue_on_error.description: Keep running after a failed entry (default true).

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo last operation
tools.description: Trigger AE's Undo command (Edit > Undo). Note: each bridge tool call is already one undo group, so this undoes the last tool call as a whole.
